definitions.explanation: Exercise focused on building muscle strength.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{筋|きん}トレをしている。
examples.english: I do strength training every day.

examples.japanese: ジムで{筋|きん}トレする。
examples.english: Do strength training at the gym.

examples.japanese: {筋|きん}トレの{効果|こうか}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: The effects of strength training are showing.

notes:
Abbreviation of {筋力|きんりょく}トレーニング (muscle strength training). Very common in fitness contexts.

Common expressions:
- {筋|きん}トレメニュー (workout routine)
- {自宅|じたく}{筋|きん}トレ (home workout)
- {筋|きん}トレグッズ (workout equipment)
